source.stem:
A car travels 6.0 km along a main road in 6.0 minutes. It then travels 2.0 km along a minor road in 6.0 minutes.
Which calculation of average speed for the whole journey is correct?

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: A sundial's shadow keeps indicating time at night without sunlight.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: A candle clock tells elapsed time by its flame getting dimmer.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: An hourglass measures time by water flowing from its upper bulb to its lower bulb.

intelligence.enrichment: A sundial uses the changing position of a Sun-cast shadow, a water clock uses water flow, an hourglass uses sand flow, and a candle clock uses marked burning to indicate the passage of time. A predictable physical change is matched to elapsed time, so observing the change gives the time indication. The learner correctly applies this rule: A sundial uses the changing position of a Sun-cast shadow, a water clock uses water flow, an hourglass uses sand flow, and a candle clock uses marked burning to indicate the passage of time. The name of an old clock is enough to identify it, without linking the device to its shadow, flow, or burning change.
